policy.retraction: same-source retraction cancels that source text support, never a screen
policy.scaling: original frozen scaler for 2026; earlier mature-only scaler for 2025
policy.missing: omit absent features; no imputation or filling from older chain items
policy.prompt: unchanged baseline prompt, deep8k request body, thinking every step
policy.decision_rule: keep only if lead improves or control false alarms fall without worsening the other; useful exits must not fall
policy.lead_rule: paired per-incident first-exit leads: no later or lost exit, at least one earlier (or fewer control alarms with nonworse leads)
policy.control_rule: both exit and exit-or-high counts must not worsen
policy.scoring: raw primary per brief; agreement and historical comparisons reported separately
